title: RecordPageSettings - Metadata API
description: Represents an org’s record page settings. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

enableActivityRelatedList.description: Indicates whether the default activities view is related lists (true) or activity timeline (false).

enableDynamicForms.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Forms is enabled for the org. Removed in API version 50.0 and later.

enableFullRecordView.description: Indicates whether the default record page view is full view (true) or grouped view (false).

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: This is a sample recordpage.settings metadata file.
